definitions: To hold a grudge or resentment about a past event or perceived wrong.
To be easily offended or quick to anger because of a sense of inferiority or injustice.
examples: He's always had a chip on his shoulder about not getting promoted.
She walks around with a chip on her shoulder, ready to argue with anyone.
Don't let a chip on your shoulder ruin your chances for success.
lemma: have a chip on your shoulder
source: have a chip on your shoulder
